what: Agnico Eagle Mines is a gold producer with mines in Canada, Finland, Australia and Mexico. Almost all of its production comes from politically stable countries, which is unusual among large gold miners.
money: mines in Ontario, Quebec, Nunavut, Finland, Australia and Mexico
moat: Long-life deposits in low-risk jurisdictions, with mining districts where it already owns the infrastructure for expansion.
risks: The gold price sets profits and it does not control it
Mining cost inflation has been persistent across the industry
Arctic operations in Nunavut are expensive and weather-dependent
A low dividend yield of about 1% compared with other income investments
opportunities: Revenue grew about 44% last year on gold prices and volumes
Net margin of 37% and return on invested capital near 18% are top of the industry
Almost no debt: about $328 million against $3.6 billion of cash
watch: All-in sustaining cost per ounce and production guidance.
